privacy: Your workbook stays in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.
invalid: Choose a readable XLS workbook. Renamed text, HTML, and modern Excel files are not XLS files. The workbook may be damaged.
protected: Password-encrypted workbooks cannot be converted. Save an unencrypted XLS copy and try again.
unsupported: This workbook contains a macro sheet, chart sheet, or another unsupported sheet type. Save its worksheet data as a regular XLS workbook and try again.
resource: This workbook needs more memory than this browser can provide. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The converter could not load. Check your connection and try again.
empty: This worksheet has no stored cell data.
previewNote: This window shows up to 20 rows and 8 columns. The download includes all worksheets and their imported cells, including hidden rows and columns.
invalidAddress: Enter a cell address within this worksheet’s used range, such as A1.
missingCaches: Some formulas have no saved result. Their formulas remain in the XLSX file, but the preview cannot calculate their values.
preserved: Worksheet names, typed cell values, supported number formats, merged cells, and supported formulas with saved results are retained. Formulas are not recalculated in this browser.
limitations: Charts, images, macros, pivot features, and advanced formatting are not preserved. Formula and external-reference support is incomplete. Check important workbooks in your spreadsheet application before relying on the conversion.
previewLimits: The preview shows cell data, including hidden cells. It does not reproduce formatting or merged-cell layout. Dates use stored Excel serial numbers and supported number formats.
